trigger.description: A context pack asked for changed-symbol boosting (--changed-symbol or --changed-symbols-from-git), but git status failed, no candidate memory carried file-span provenance, or none of their Rust sources was readable, so the boost was skipped; or a source failed to parse, or a memory's span no longer resolved to one symbol (an invalid line span, a missing source file, a renamed or deleted symbol, or two equally specific containing symbols), so the boost ran on partial evidence. Symbols are extracted from sources on every pack; there is no persisted snapshot.

expected_emission.repair_string: Symbols are re-read from workspace sources on every pack, so there is no index to rebuild; check that `git status` runs in the workspace, that the memories carry file-span provenance whose spans still match a symbol, and that their Rust sources are readable and parse.
